text:
zoe: morning 👋 first day here and hitting a couple of setup snags. Okta MFA push never shows up on my phone, Drive doesn't have the 'Welcome - Eng' folder, and 1Password invite says 'pending seat'. who should I poke?

it-support: hey @zoe welcome! for the Okta push, which phone did you register? iOS or Android and did you enroll Authenticator in Okta or use SMS?
zoe: iPhone 13, iOS 16.5. I tried the Authenticator app (the Okta Verify QR) during the flow but it says 'no devices found' and the push never appears.
matt: sometimes the Okta Verify app fails if time sync is off. open Settings -> General -> Date & Time and enable Set Automatically. also try removing the app and re-scanning the QR.
zoe: time was correct. reinstalled Okta Verify and rescanned; it shows my factor now but test push still times out.
it-support: can you paste the last 10 lines of the Okta client log from the app (redact ~ tokens)? if not, we'll check from the admin console.
zoe: pasted log snippet: ```2026-03-23 08:21:45 OktaVerify[1234]: Registered factor id=facr_0x9a
2026-03-23 08:22:10 OktaVerify[1234]: Push sent factor=facr_0x9a status=timeout
2026-03-23 08:22:20 OktaVerify[1234]: Network reachable: YES```
people-ops: looping in People Ops to check license/seat for 1Password and Drive shares. @people-ops can you confirm if the 'Welcome - Eng' folder is shared to the new-hire group and whether contractors vs full-time have different seat provisioning?
people-ops: @zoe thanks — can you DM me which offer email you used? Contractors occasionally get a different group tag that delays auto-share. I'll check.
zoe: DM'd email.
mat:t: quick check from admin side: your Okta profile had an old recovery phone field which sometimes blocks push if policy requires device trust. cleared recovery phone and reset the factor from admin console. Try approving the push again.
zoe: ok push finally worked — approved and got in. thanks Matt.
it-support: great. For Drive: we've got an automated share to the "new-hires-engineering" group but because your account was temporarily labeled contractor:zoe it didn't get included. People Ops updated your group tag to eng-newhire and re-shared. You should see 'Welcome - Eng' under Shared with me; use Add shortcut to Drive to pin it.
people-ops: 1Password seat: system shows 0/50 seats available for contractors pool; i've moved you to the full-time pool and triggered a provision. expect the invite within ~10 minutes.
devops-bot: Ticket #ONB-3017 created (category: provisioning). assignee: it-support. ETA 90 minutes.
zoe: got the 1Password invite a few minutes later — accepted. Drive shortcut added. all set now. thanks everyone for the quick help! :tada:
people-ops: welcome aboard @zoe! we'll follow up with a short checklist DM for any remaining billing/contract paperwork.
zoe: awesome, appreciate it — excited to get started :)
